---
description: Enforce accessibility standards from github.com/fecarrico/A11Y.md for frontend work.
applyTo: '**/*.{html,scss,tsx}'
---

Follow the accessibility rules defined at <https://github.com/fecarrico/A11Y.md>.

Target the highest feasible compliance profile:

1. Shield
2. Strict
3. Launchpad

Only fall back if a higher profile is infeasible. Never reduce compliance merely for convenience.
